items.grounds: Re-derived from bytes with the staged tools (collate.py batch, sweep.py, citation_sweep.py). The four verse-initial openers spliced from verse_map_oshb.json are דּ֭וֹר (oshb:Prov.30.11), דּ֭וֹר (oshb:Prov.30.12), דּ֭וֹר (oshb:Prov.30.13) and דּ֤וֹר (oshb:Prov.30.14), each collating at byte tier at its own ref; the first three carry U+05AD (dehi) and the fourth U+05A4 (mahpakh), so the row's single pointed form is byte-identical at 3 of the 4 sites and collates at oshb:Prov.30.14 only at accent_stripped tier (sweep of the pointed form דּ֭וֹר: byte 3 verses = 30:11-13; accent_stripped 4 verses = 30:11-14; skeleton 5 verses = 27:24 + 30:11-14, 7 token occurrences, the three 27:24 hits all non-initial), while the verse-initial skeleton token דור is exactly 4 verses book-wide (30:11-14), so the anaphoric chain and the 4-of-4 digit are true at accent_stripped and skeleton tier and the cluster warrant survives. Tested the row against the finding: boundary_rationale asserts 'the identical word' with one pointed splice cited to the range oshb:Prov.30.11-Prov.30.14 and '4 of 4 verses share the same opening token', and observed_substrate_signals cites that same dehi-pointed form as 'repeated at' oshb:Prov.30.14, with no tier named anywhere in the row; the staged citation_sweep.py binds each Hebrew run to the NEAREST oshb: ref in its field and the range window contains the form, so the row passes the machine collate arm (re-run over the three shipped rows: GREEN, 0 problems, 0 nfd_degraded) while the per-site identity it asserts is false at the fourth site at byte tier - the tier overclaim the standing tier-discipline rule forbids (accent-stripped identity presented as pointed identity; a rule in force at the book's writing, not a later convention, so not dampened). Severity: the mis-tiered claim is the cluster's sole cohesion evidence, but the cohesion is real at the tier that supports it and no boundary moves, so this is a defective warrant claim not alone load-bearing - medium as filed; not high because the claim is not byte-false in substance, not low because it sits on the driver claim, not on a mechanical field. The proposed field repair is byte-sound and endorsed as a PROPOSAL only (span unchanged, applied nowhere): name the tier (identical at accent_stripped and skeleton tier, 4 of 4 verse-initial; sweep object the verse-initial skeleton token דור, 4 verses book-wide) and splice the fourth opener דּ֤וֹר with its own inline ref oshb:Prov.30.14, at which it collates at byte tier. both_sides_assessed is false because this is a tier-discipline item on the cluster's internal opener chain and concerns no seam; both seams are weighed under the sibling item on this row. Adjudicator note: same model family as the auditor, so this agreement is one correlated M8 voice reached by independent byte re-derivation, not independent confirmation.

Re-derived from bytes both ways (sweep.py, collate.py batch, pmarks_Prov.json, check_marks.py). Front seam weighed from both sides at byte tier: the preceding row's closing (and only) verse is אַל תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל אדנו אֲדֹנָ֑יו פֶּֽן יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ (oshb:Prov.30.10; the inline unpointed ketiv אדנו before the qere אֲדֹנָ֑יו is the K/Q inventory's one note at that verse and is disclosed here because the quoted span crosses it), a self-contained vetitive that closes on its own motive clause; the row's opening verse is דּ֭וֹר אָבִ֣יו יְקַלֵּ֑ל וְאֶת אִ֝מּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְבָרֵֽךְ (oshb:Prov.30.11), the first link of the verse-initial דור chain that is exactly 4 verses book-wide (30:11-14). The straddling device is byte-true and undisclosed at both edges: a skeleton sweep of the prefixed curse-form יקלל returns exactly 2 verses and 2 token occurrences book-wide, oshb:Prov.30.10 (יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥) and oshb:Prov.30.11 (יְקַלֵּ֑ל), and the three-letter skeleton קלל returns 5 verses (20:20, 26:2, 27:14, 30:10, 30:11), so the adjacent pair is book-wide unique at the yiqtol-piel object; at the exact shared-content-token object the two verses share 0 skeleton tokens (the object suffix separates the forms), which is the only object on which the preceding row's unqualified 'shares no anaphoric opening or catchword' sentence is true - it names no object, and at lexeme level it is false (same verb, same stem, same person, argued from the pointed bytes since no morphology layer is staged). The row's boundary_evidence_refs carry web:Prov.30.11-Prov.30.14, oshb:Prov.30.14 (petuchah, single-witness), web:Prov.17.1 and web:Prov.30.15 and nothing at oshb:Prov.30.10, and its strongest_rejected_alternative answers only atomization, never the rival extension 30:10-14, so the cluster warrant is incomplete on the side where live counter-evidence sits (the cross-seam cohesion rule treats an undisclosed straddling device as arguing continuity against the edge until disclosed). Governing rule: the seam nonetheless holds on the construction-run onset - 30:10 opens on the vetitive particle and carries no דור token, the anaphora begins at 30:11 and its byte cohesion is exactly coextensive with the span, and one shared lexeme is a catchword pair, not a chain or a shared construction; the WLC parashah layer (pmarks: PE at Prov.30.9 and PE at Prov.30.14, so 30:10-14 is one open paragraph) is tier-3 weak corroboration compatible with the extension but never a driver, and by the book's own rule the absence of a mark after 30:10 is never counterevidence, so the layer neither decides nor overturns. Back seam weighed coherently: the row's closing verse opens דּ֤וֹר חֲרָב֣וֹת שִׁנָּיו֮ (oshb:Prov.30.14) and shares 0 skeleton content tokens with the following row's opening לַֽעֲלוּקָ֨ה שְׁתֵּ֥י בָנוֹת֮ (oshb:Prov.30.15); the PE at oshb:Prov.30.14 is inventory-validated (check_marks.py over the three shipped rows: GREEN, 0 flags) and the three/four formula onset at 30:15 is a different ruled form, so the back seam is clean and no respan follows in either direction. Verdict: confirm at medium - a defective (incomplete) cluster warrant at the front edge with a byte-true, book-wide-unique, undisclosed link, not alone load-bearing because the ruled onset device decides; not low because the standing rule makes an undisclosed straddle live counter-evidence rather than a mechanical shortfall. The proposed field repair is byte-sound and endorsed as a PROPOSAL only (span unchanged, applied nowhere), with the qualification that the object be named exactly: add oshb:Prov.30.10 to boundary_evidence_refs and one sentence naming the skeleton yiqtol-piel form יקלל (2 verses book-wide, both at this seam; root-level קלל 5 verses; exact shared content tokens 0) and disposing of it against the anaphoric chain; coherently, the preceding row's no-catchword sentence should name its object (exact shared content tokens, 0) and disclose the same lexeme link - recorded as the companion proposal on the same seam, ruled coherently with this item, applied nowhere.
